import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int p_input_value = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int k_input_value = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        final long MODULO = 1000000007L;

        if (k_input_value == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_input_value, p_input_value - 1, MODULO));
        } else if (k_input_value == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_input_value, p_input_value, MODULO));
        } else {
            List<Integer> divisors = computeDivisors(p_input_value - 1);
            for (int divisor_candidate : divisors) {
                if ((p_input_value - 1) % divisor_candidate == 0 && powMod(k_input_value, divisor_candidate, p_input_value) == 1) {
                    long result = powMod(p_input_value, (p_input_value - 1) / divisor_candidate, MODULO);
                    System.out.println(result);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static List<Integer> computeDivisors(int n) {
        Set<Integer> divisorsSet = new HashSet<>();
        int i = 1;
        while (i * i <= n) {
            if (n % i == 0) {
                divisorsSet.add(i);
                divisorsSet.add(n / i);
            }
            i++;
        }
        List<Integer> divisorsList = new ArrayList<>(divisorsSet);
        Collections.sort(divisorsList);
        return divisorsList;
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        base = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
